skill.name: branch
skill.description: Creates Git branches for SDD specification and implementation work, using spec/* or impl/* names and explicit user confirmation.
skill.summary: Guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Git branch creation for SDD workflows.
skill.author: Clionegohan

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, and inline examples. The remaining concern is semantic: the documented Git checkout command uses a branch-name placeholder that should be validated before any shell execution.

remediation.suggestion: Validate action-id and description values, reject shell metacharacters, and pass branch names as Git arguments instead of shell text.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Branch Name in Git Command
semantic_findings.description: The skill accepts action-id and description values, then documents git checkout with a branch-name placeholder. If an agent interpolates unsafe text into a shell command, branch names could be misinterpreted as shell syntax or Git options.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The placeholder and user-controlled inputs are visible, but no executable implementation is included. Risk depends on how Claude, Codex, or Claude Code runs the documented command.

content.value_statement: Manual branch naming can slow specification and implementation workflows. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to create consistent spec and impl branches.
actual_capabilities: Creates branch names using spec or impl prefixes and action IDs.
Supports optional short descriptions when forming branch names.
Prompts for confirmation before branch creation.
Shows the base branch and current branch after completion.
Provides handling options for existing branches and uncommitted changes.
limitations: Requires a Git repository and local command access.
Does not define a script or automated validation logic.
Does not manage remote branches after local creation.
Depends on another workflow to provide accurate action IDs.

use_cases.title: Start a specification branch
use_cases.description: Create a spec branch before drafting requirements or design notes.

use_cases.title: Open an implementation branch
use_cases.description: Create an impl branch before coding an approved action item.

use_cases.title: Standardize branch naming
use_cases.description: Keep team branches aligned with action IDs and short descriptions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a spec branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the branch skill to create a spec branch for action 001-01-01 with description user-auth. Ask before running Git commands.

prompt_templates.title: Create an implementation branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an impl branch for action 001-01-01 using the current repository. Confirm the base branch and branch name first.

prompt_templates.title: Handle an existing branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a spec branch for action 002-02-03. If it already exists, show safe options before switching or creating another branch.

prompt_templates.title: Run a guarded branch workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an impl branch for action 003-04-05 payment-retry. Validate the branch name, check local changes, and ask before each Git action.

output_examples.input: Create a spec branch for action 001-01-01 named user auth.
output: Status: waiting for confirmation before creating the branch

output_examples.input: Start implementation for action 002-03-04 with description audit-log.
output: Options: stash changes, commit changes, or cancel branch creation

best_practices: Confirm the base branch and branch name before creating anything.
Use short descriptions with letters, numbers, and hyphens.
Resolve uncommitted changes before switching branches.
anti_patterns: Using long descriptions or unsupported characters in branch names.
Discarding local changes just to make branch creation easier.

faq.question: What branch types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports spec branches for planning and impl branches for implementation work.

faq.question: Does it create remote branches?
faq.answer: No. It describes local branch creation and does not publish branches to a remote repository.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is written for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code environments with Git access.

faq.question: Does it require user confirmation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the assistant to ask before creating a branch.

faq.question: What happens if the branch already exists?
faq.answer: The skill asks the user to switch branches, choose another name, or delete the existing branch.

faq.question: What should I check before using it?
faq.answer: Check your current branch, uncommitted changes, and the generated branch name.
